t: This is the Catholic church of Our Lady of Pity and St Simon Stock, in Putney. Simon Stock was an English priest and saint of the thirteenth century, and an early prior of the Carmelite Order. Tradition says the Virgin Mary appeared to him and gave him the Brown Scapular. Devotion to him is usually linked with Our Lady of Mount Carmel. So the church carries a saint whose story is bound up with one of the best-known Catholic devotions.
